description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade the application runtime and project format to the latest .NET LTS version.
tasks.reason: The application currently targets .NET Framework 4.8 and needs modernization to align with the requested latest framework and cloud-native readiness.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the application to .NET 10 (latest LTS), including project format modernization required for the target runtime while preserving existing business behavior.

tasks.description: Modernize the application to use Azure cloud-native services for configuration, identity, and data access.
tasks.reason: The modernization goal requires moving from local and legacy patterns to Azure-native managed services.
tasks.requirements: Migrate application configuration and secrets management to Azure App Configuration and Azure Key Vault, migrate SQL connectivity to Azure SQL Database, and use Managed Identity for service authentication.

tasks.description: Scan and remediate CVEs in dependencies before deployment.
tasks.reason: Security remediation is required in every modernization plan and should be completed before deployment.
tasks.requirements: Scan dependencies for known CVEs, upgrade to patched versions, document major-version remediation risk when applicable, and verify build and tests pass after fixes.

tasks.description: Deploy the modernized application to Azure Container Apps.
tasks.reason: The user explicitly requested deploying the modernized application to Azure.
tasks.requirements: Containerize and deploy the application to Azure Container Apps, configure runtime settings for cloud operation, and validate deployment readiness.
